{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
completed_df['revenue_float'] = completed_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = completed_df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
internal_test_count = internal_test_mask.sum()

# Exclude internal test orders
filtered_df = completed_df[~internal_test_mask]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_float'].sum()

# Print results
total_revenue_formatted = f'{total_revenue:,.2f}'
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue_formatted}')"}
